⚡ Language models

Transformer

In simple words

A neural network design from 2017 that uses attention to work out how the words of a text relate.

A neural network design from 2017 that uses “attention” to look at all the words of a text at once and work out how they relate. Most modern language models are built on it.

Example. The “T” in GPT stands for “Transformer”.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 9: How Chatbots Write

Related words

  • Large language model (LLM)A huge neural network trained on enormous amounts of text to predict the next token.
  • AttentionThe part of a transformer that lets each word look at the other words and decide which of them matter for its meaning.
  • Neural networkAn AI model made of many simple connected units (neurons), arranged in layers, that learn patterns together.
